issues.description: Class name mismatch: the UML diagram in problem_statement.md declares the class as 'Course' (line 63) while the template and solution Java files declare and use the class name 'Lecture' (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, line 3). This naming inconsistency can confuse students about which class the UML refers to and where the listed attributes/methods should be implemented.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML diagram use the class name 'Lecture' to match the exercise text and code. In problem_statement.md change the UML class declaration line from 'class Course {' to 'class Lecture {' (and update any inline references inside the UML block accordingly). Alternatively, if the intended class name is 'Course', rename the Java files and references in template/solution to 'Course' consistently, but prefer changing the UML to 'Lecture' to minimize disruption.
